description: This is a React component representing a Bank Details form page. It manages user inputs for account number, IFSC code, full name for e-sign, and other related information. The component fetches existing bank details, performs live validation and lookup of IFSC codes, and submits data via API calls.

methods.name: BankDetails
methods.description: Main functional React component rendering the bank details form, handling state, effects, validation, and API interactions.
